s: A plague of locusts ruins the land. Call a fast and cry to the Lord.
Rend your hearts, not your garments. God will pour out his Spirit on all flesh.
The nations are judged in the valley of Jehoshaphat, and God dwells in Zion.

1: In older English “corn” meant any grain, such as wheat or barley.
The elders: the senior men who led the people, a city or the Church.
